info.title: Mahara Match - WP5 Admin & Ministry API
info.description:
WP5 owns the governance of the shared referential: skills, occupations, and the review of labels proposed by the ingestion pipelines. Entities and schemas come from WP1's `mahara_data` package; WP5 owns the lifecycle, not the model.

Every error follows WP1's `ApiError` contract.

get.description: Answers as long as the process is up. No dependency is checked here.
Checks every dependency WP5 needs before it can serve traffic.
